selection_basis: Recommendations that can change resource escalation, data inclusion, evaluation publication, runtime activation, or safety-critical execution.

claims.applies_when: Any book model output is connected to a real or simulated driving control path.
claims.required_action: Route execution through an independently specified vehicle and safety gate with auditable inputs and outputs.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Keep the output advisory-only when the independent gate or its acceptance evidence is unavailable.
claims.not_authorized: A successful book fixture does not authorize direct vehicle control or road deployment.

claims.applies_when: A reader considers moving beyond deterministic CPU fixtures to downloaded data or GPU runs.
claims.required_action: Complete the S-tier contract first and record hardware, data license, cost, and unresolved performance claims.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Remain at S tier and leave M/L work pending when hardware, permission, or download budget is unclear.
claims.not_authorized: The book does not require hardware purchase or permit unmeasured 24 GB and realtime claims.

claims.applies_when: Driving training or evaluation consumes sensor frames, map transforms, timestamps, or duration-bearing actions.
claims.required_action: Declare every consumed frame, transform, clock basis, and action duration and verify them on a fixed trajectory.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Mark unverifiable fields invalid and exclude dependent samples or tasks instead of inventing defaults.
claims.not_authorized: Schema presence alone does not prove calibration, synchronization, or road validity.

claims.applies_when: Episodes share routes, scenes, operators, objects, or other correlated acquisition units.
claims.required_action: Split at the declared correlation unit and record overlap audits before reporting generalization.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Downgrade the result to an in-distribution diagnostic when leakage-safe grouping cannot be established.
claims.not_authorized: Random frame splitting does not authorize a route-generalization or scene-generalization claim.

claims.applies_when: Training or evaluation contains stochastic seeds, episode sampling, or policy-environment interaction.
claims.required_action: Report seed and episode structure separately and choose training seed count from the claim and cost profile.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Use descriptive single-run language when replication is unavailable and retain the uncertainty as a limitation.
claims.not_authorized: Many episodes from one trained seed do not authorize a claim about training variability.

claims.applies_when: A driving predictor exposes uncertainty to a planner, controller, or safety gateway.
claims.required_action: Separate data noise from support or OOD uncertainty and test the downstream response to each signal.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Abstain, reduce the operating domain, or use an independent safe planner when uncertainty is unsupported.
claims.not_authorized: A calibrated pixel loss does not authorize safe planning under distribution shift.

claims.applies_when: A learned world model proposes candidate driving trajectories or action sequences.
claims.required_action: Pass candidates through independent feasibility, rule, collision, and fallback layers before execution.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Reject all candidates and invoke the predefined safe path when none pass every required layer.
claims.not_authorized: High predicted return does not authorize bypassing independent driving constraints.

claims.applies_when: An imagination-trained actor is evaluated or connected to a physical or traffic environment.
claims.required_action: Run independent closed-loop evaluation with explicit intervention, termination, and safety outcomes.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Keep the actor offline or advisory-only if the independent closed-loop gate is absent or fails.
claims.not_authorized: Imagined return or latent consistency does not authorize execution.

claims.applies_when: A benchmark result will support a comparison, chapter conclusion, or release claim.
claims.required_action: Freeze the benchmark card, evaluator version, denominator, exclusions, and aggregation before the result run.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Label post-hoc changes exploratory and rerun the frozen protocol before making a confirmatory claim.
claims.not_authorized: A mutable evaluator does not authorize a stable ranking or longitudinal comparison.

claims.applies_when: Driving prediction includes other agents whose reactions depend on ego action.
claims.required_action: Declare the other-agent behavior model, interaction protocol, and ego-action conditioning used in evaluation.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Restrict the claim to open-loop replay when interactive agent response is not modeled or tested.
claims.not_authorized: Plausible video continuation does not authorize an interactive traffic response claim.

claims.applies_when: A generative action policy supplies commands to a driving stack.
claims.required_action: Validate action semantics, timing, selector behavior, constraints, and independent safety filtering end to end.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Reject or hand control to the predefined fallback when no sampled action passes the executable gate.
claims.not_authorized: Diverse or visually plausible samples do not authorize driving execution.

claims.applies_when: A VLM or language-conditioned model contributes to an automated driving decision path.
claims.required_action: Limit it to low-frequency candidate generation and validate commands through deterministic executable contracts.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Ignore malformed, late, unsupported, or unsafe candidates and retain the independent controller.
claims.not_authorized: Natural-language fluency does not authorize high-frequency actuation or safety arbitration.

claims.applies_when: A world model evaluates or selects a policy that changes the visited state-action distribution.
claims.required_action: Test policy-induced distribution shift and separate proxy ranking from actual closed-loop outcome evidence.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Restrict conclusions to the tested policy population when prospective support coverage is unavailable.
claims.not_authorized: Agreement on a fixed dataset does not authorize ranking new policies or OOD scenarios.

claims.applies_when: Post-trained VLA or WAM components enter an automated-driving evaluation or execution path.
claims.required_action: Use an independent evaluator and gateway for action validity, closed-loop outcome, timing, and safety.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Keep the component offline when independent evaluation or a valid fallback path is unavailable.
claims.not_authorized: Joint post-training loss does not authorize road deployment or direct control.

claims.applies_when: A study switches physics solver, accelerator path, or simulator backend while comparing performance.
claims.required_action: Hold model, initial state, and actions fixed and compare trajectory, contact, termination, and outcome divergence.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Report backends separately and treat backend as an experiment variable when tolerance or outcome changes.
claims.not_authorized: Higher throughput does not authorize claims of equivalent physics or task validity.

claims.applies_when: A driving question may be evaluated in lightweight MetaDrive or higher-fidelity CARLA scenarios.
claims.required_action: Start with the least costly simulator that can answer the declared question and escalate on identified evidence gaps.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Stop at the lighter tier with explicit limitations when compute, assets, or scenario permission is unavailable.
claims.not_authorized: Scores from different simulators do not authorize a direct numerical ranking across backends.

claims.applies_when: A chapter, report, or release publishes task success rates.
claims.required_action: Expose task population, initialization, definitions, timeout, retry, valid denominator, exclusions, and per-task results.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Publish only incomplete descriptive evidence and omit a headline aggregate when required fields are missing.
claims.not_authorized: A filtered numerator and denominator do not authorize a representative overall success claim.

claims.applies_when: Results come from benchmark cards with different tasks, protocols, metrics, or aggregation rules.
claims.required_action: Compare only within compatible frozen cards or state the differences without collapsing them into one ranking.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Use a qualitative side-by-side account when compatibility cannot be demonstrated.
claims.not_authorized: A shared metric name does not authorize cross-benchmark numerical comparison.

claims.applies_when: Perception, policy, controller, and gateway execute asynchronously or at different rates.
claims.required_action: Monitor data age, queueing, deadlines, cancellation, and end-to-end reaction time under load.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Drop stale commands and enter the predefined safe mode when deadline or freshness contracts fail.
claims.not_authorized: Fast isolated inference does not authorize a realtime or safe end-to-end claim.

claims.applies_when: A runtime gateway must respond to invalid, late, uncertain, or unsafe model output.
claims.required_action: Select only embodiment-specific validated fallback modes with entry, completion, failure, and recovery rules.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Refuse activation or leave the operating domain when no reachable validated fallback exists.
claims.not_authorized: A language model may not invent fallback behavior or select a merely name-matched mode.

claims.applies_when: A driving system claims a minimum-risk maneuver or other safety fallback.
claims.required_action: Define scenario-specific maneuver selection and test reachability, traffic interaction, completion, and failure.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Do not activate the claimed operating domain when no tested maneuver can safely handle required failures.
claims.not_authorized: Naming an MRM does not authorize assuming it is reachable or safe in every scene.

claims.applies_when: An uncertainty score controls abstention, escalation, or a runtime safety gate.
claims.required_action: Version the score, calibration data, threshold, operating domain, and downstream response together.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Disable or conservatively revalidate the gate after model, data, threshold, or domain drift.
claims.not_authorized: A scalar confidence score does not authorize universal calibration or safety coverage.

claims.applies_when: The capstone includes an automated-driving branch or reports driving-task completion.
claims.required_action: Report task completion separately from collision, intervention, rule, timing, and fallback outcomes.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Keep the driving branch in simulation or advisory mode unless its independent safety gates pass.
claims.not_authorized: Task completion does not authorize a road-safety or deployment claim.

claims.applies_when: The capstone produces a final result intended to support the book conclusion or release.
claims.required_action: Run independent final evaluation from frozen artifacts and retain environment, command, log, and result provenance.
claims.fallback_or_stop: Publish the outcome as provisional when independent rerun or provenance artifacts are incomplete.
claims.not_authorized: A development-loop best run does not authorize the final headline conclusion.
